Hair growth supplements `work best when you have an underlying nutrient deficiency` . Most over-the-counter formulas are not FDA-approved to treat genetic pattern baldness.[[1]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/the-best-vitamins-supplements-and-products-for-healthier-hair)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/AADskin/videos/do-biotin-supplements-really-help-with-hair-loss-heres-what-board-certified-derm/1057516907235066/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DPVacn53y30)

- **Biotin (Vitamin B7):** Supports keratin production. It is popular, though high doses do not speed up growth unless you are deficient and can mess up lab tests (like thyroid and heart checks).[[1]](https://www.ulta.com/discover/beauty-education/best-vitamins-for-hair-growth)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/AADskin/videos/do-biotin-supplements-really-help-with-hair-loss-heres-what-board-certified-derm/1057516907235066/)
- **Iron:** Vital for oxygen delivery to follicles. Low iron is a common cause of hair shedding in women.[[1]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/the-best-vitamins-supplements-and-products-for-healthier-hair)[[2]](https://www.ulta.com/discover/beauty-education/best-vitamins-for-hair-growth)
- **Vitamin D:** Plays a role in the hair growth cycle. Deficiencies are linked to alopecia.[[1]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/the-best-vitamins-supplements-and-products-for-healthier-hair)[[2]](https://www.ulta.com/discover/beauty-education/best-vitamins-for-hair-growth)
- **Zinc:** Helps with follicle repair and reduces scalp inflammation.[[1]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/the-best-vitamins-supplements-and-products-for-healthier-hair)
- **Multi-Ingredient Formulas:** Brands like Nutrafol Women's Balance or [Viviscal Hair Growth Supplements](https://www.viviscal.com/products/womans-hair-growth-supplements) blend marine proteins, adaptogens (like ashwagandha), and vitamins to target stress and structural support.[[1]](https://www.amazon.com/Nutrafol-Supplements-Clinically-Dermatologist-Recommended/dp/B07QZ5CTTF)[[2]](https://www.ulta.com/discover/beauty-education/best-vitamins-for-hair-growth)

### Important Safety Tips

- **Lab Interference:** High-dose biotin can alter critical blood test results.[[1]](https://www.facebook.com/AADskin/videos/do-biotin-supplements-really-help-with-hair-loss-heres-what-board-certified-derm/1057516907235066/)
- **Iron Caution:** Do not take extra iron unless a blood test shows you are low.[[1]](https://www.ulta.com/discover/beauty-education/best-vitamins-for-hair-growth)
- **Medical Review:** Consult a dermatologist or doctor to rule out thyroid issues, hormone shifts, or stress-related shedding before starting pills.[[1]](https://www.facebook.com/AADskin/videos/do-biotin-supplements-really-help-with-hair-loss-heres-what-board-certified-derm/1057516907235066/)

- **Your age or life stage** (e.g., postpartum, menopause)
